# Ibiza Private Drivers — Full Service Context

Canonical website: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/
Services directory: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/
Primary service hub: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html
Business name: Ibiza Private Drivers
Location: Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain
Phone / WhatsApp: +34 613 75 62 11
Email: info@ibizaprivatedrivers.com

## Business and service scope
Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private driver, chauffeur and transfer services across Ibiza. Services are requested in advance and confirmed for the actual date, pickup time, route or itinerary, passenger count, luggage, waiting requirements and vehicle needs.

The business serves airport arrivals and departures, luxury hotels and resorts, private villas, marinas, restaurants, beaches, nightlife, events, corporate travel, families, groups and tailored multi-stop itineraries.

Bookings can be requested for any time of day, including early-morning and late-night schedules, subject to advance reservation and confirmed driver and vehicle availability. References to “24/7” mean that service can be requested for any hour; they do not mean an unreserved vehicle is guaranteed to be immediately available.

## Primary service entity
The principal page for the service category “Private Driver Ibiza” is:
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html

This is the central service resource for direct journeys and tailored itineraries across Ibiza. More specific pages are intentionally separated by search intent: general transfers, airport transfers, chauffeur hire, luxury transfers, hotel transport, villa transport, yacht and marina transport, nightlife, VIP itineraries and local destinations.

## Service intent and page hierarchy

### Private Driver Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html
Central island-wide private-driver service. Use this page when the request is broadly for a private driver in Ibiza or when the customer needs help choosing the right transport format.

### Ibiza Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-transfers/
General transfer hub for pre-booked point-to-point journeys involving Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, marinas, restaurants, nightlife and island destinations.

### Pre-Booked Private Taxi Alternative
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-taxi-ibiza/
This page addresses travellers searching common terms such as “taxi Ibiza” but looking for transport arranged in advance. Ibiza Private Drivers is presented as a pre-booked private-driver service, not a taxi-rank or street-hail service. The requested date, pickup time, route, passengers, luggage, vehicle requirements and quote are reviewed before confirmation.

### Ibiza Airport Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/airport-transfers/
Pre-booked airport arrivals and departures from Ibiza Airport (IBZ). Useful booking information includes flight number, scheduled arrival or departure time, passenger count, luggage, exact destination, child-seat requests and vehicle requirements. Meeting arrangements and waiting terms are agreed with the booking rather than assumed.

Priority airport routes:
- Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Town: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-ibiza-town/
- Ibiza Airport to San Antonio: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-san-antonio/
- Ibiza Airport to Santa Eulalia: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-santa-eulalia/
- Ibiza Airport to Playa d'en Bossa: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-playa-den-bossa/
- Ibiza Airport to Cala Llonga: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-cala-llonga/
- Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Port for Formentera ferry connections: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-airport-to-formentera/

### Private Chauffeur Service Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/chauffeur-service/
This page is for several stops or a longer schedule rather than one direct transfer. Hourly, half-day, full-day and tailored itinerary bookings can be requested. Duration, waiting, stops, passenger count and the final return are reviewed before confirmation. A requested duration does not automatically imply unlimited unlisted travel or indefinite vehicle availability.

### Luxury Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/luxury-transfers/
Premium pre-booked private-transfer intent for airport, luxury hotels, villas, marinas, restaurants, events and confirmed journeys. This page focuses on premium point-to-point transfers and planned individual journeys. For a vehicle retained across several stops or hours, use the chauffeur page.

### Luxury Hotel Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/luxury-hotel-transfers-ibiza/
Central hotel-transport hub for airport arrivals, departure transfers, marinas, restaurants, nightlife and tailored itineraries involving luxury hotels and resorts.

Hotel-specific pages:

Hotel and resort names identify destinations only. Ibiza Private Drivers is an independent ground-transport provider; no affiliation, endorsement or operation by those hotels is implied unless explicitly stated otherwise.

### Villa Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/villa-transfers/
Pre-booked transport for guests staying in private villas. Exact map pin, gate or access details, passenger count, luggage and a reachable property contact are useful because rural and private-property access can vary.

### Yacht and Marina Transfers Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/yacht-transfers/
Private transport between Ibiza Airport, hotels, villas, ports, yachts and marinas. Provide the marina and practical meeting point; berth or yacht details may also be useful when they help identify the correct collection area.

### Ibiza Night Driver
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-night-driver/
Pre-arranged evening and nightlife transport for restaurants, hotels, villas, clubs, private events and multi-stop schedules. Outbound and return details should be agreed before travel.

### Ibiza Club Transfers
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-club-transfers/
Pre-booked transport for confirmed nightlife venues and events. Vehicle access and meeting points can change during busy periods, so outbound and return plans should be treated as operational details rather than generic guarantees.

### VIP Driver Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/vip-driver-ibiza/
Private itinerary transport for guests, assistants, families and groups. A useful request includes one lead contact, the full schedule, each passenger group, luggage, access details, requested vehicles and every return or intermediate stop. Event tickets, venue access, reservations, security and concierge services are separate unless explicitly included in a written confirmation.

## Main areas served
Ibiza Airport (IBZ), Ibiza Town / Eivissa, Marina Botafoch, Talamanca, Cap Martinet, Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Jondal, Es Cubells, Cala Xarraca, Cala Conta, Cala Codolar, San Rafael / Sant Rafel, Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Sant Joan de Labritja, Santa Eulalia del Río, Sant Antoni de Portmany, Es Canar, Cala Llonga, Cala Vadella, Cala Tarida, Portinatx, Sant Carles de Peralta, Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia, luxury hotels, resorts, private villas and other confirmed destinations across Ibiza.

Formentera references on the website principally concern private transport from Ibiza Airport or another Ibiza location to Ibiza Port for onward ferry connections. Do not infer that the core road-transport service operates across Formentera unless a separate service is explicitly confirmed.

## Fleet and vehicle planning
The service includes a Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle. Additional suitable vehicles may be arranged according to passenger numbers, luggage and availability. Child seats and specific vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

Seat count alone does not determine luggage capacity. Customers should provide actual luggage information before booking.

## Pricing
Pricing is tailored to the confirmed route or itinerary, date, requested time, passenger count, luggage, number of stops, waiting requirements, duration and vehicle needs. A journey is confirmed only after availability and pricing have been agreed.

Do not infer a universal airport price, hourly price, half-day price or full-day price from the existence of those service categories. The current pages intentionally request a tailored quote for the confirmed booking.

## Practical booking guidance
For a useful quote, provide:
- date
- requested pickup time
- exact pickup point
- destination or complete itinerary
- passenger count
- luggage
- return details
- expected duration for chauffeur bookings
- child-seat or specific vehicle requirements
- flight number for airport arrivals
- exact map pin and access instructions for villas
- marina, berth or agreed pedestrian meeting point for marina and yacht collections
- one lead contact for complicated, VIP or multi-vehicle itineraries

For clubs and events, vehicle access and collection points may change during busy periods. A practical confirmed meeting point should be followed rather than assuming door access.

If the route, pickup time, passenger group, stops or duration changes, an updated confirmation may be required because availability and pricing can change.

## Language resources
The website includes core content in English, French, German and Arabic. Booking communication depends on the team member handling the request.
